reason: I always get three quotes from local firms I can actually go and see, and a Kuwait outfit with no UK office, no past clients and no reviews doesn't make my shortlist. Pay-when-happy is clever, but for a business my size the real cost is my time chasing a firm I can't pop round to.
objection: No track record and nobody local I can hold to account. If something breaks after launch or my Google listing drops, I'm messaging someone in another time zone, and I don't have time for back-and-forth calls.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing two or three live sites they've built for Manchester businesses like mine, with owners I could ring, plus a written support promise with UK-hours response times.
